title: Aletheia — Events, storage and integrity
description: Reads the ClickHouse system of record and Loki. Storage panels are computed live from system.parts (spec §17).

list.name: source_id
list.label: Source
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_id FROM aletheia.events ORDER BY source_id

panels.title: Unified output — every source, one schema

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(recv_time, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS time, source_id, count() AS events FROM aletheia.events WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_time) AND source_id IN ($source_id) GROUP BY time, source_id ORDER BY time

panels.title: Parse status mix
panels.description: full / partial / raw_only. Nothing is ever dropped: an unmatched event is raw_only + verbatim.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(parse_status) AS status, count() AS events FROM aletheia.events WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_time) AND source_id IN ($source_id) GROUP BY status ORDER BY events DESC

panels.title: Verified rate per source
panels.description: Share of events stored as verified templates (spec §17).

targets.rawSql: SELECT source_id, count() AS events, countIf(storage_mode = 'template') AS verified, countIf(storage_mode = 'template') / count() AS verified_rate, countIf(parse_status = 'raw_only') AS quarantined FROM aletheia.events WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_time) GROUP BY source_id ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT template_id, any(pack_version) AS pack_version, count() AS events FROM aletheia.events WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_time) AND source_id IN ($source_id) GROUP BY template_id ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Compressed bytes on disk: Aletheia vs baseline
panels.description: From system.parts. baseline_events holds raw + normalized JSON, both ZSTD — the realistic baseline of spec §17.

targets.rawSql: SELECT table AS dataset, sum(data_compressed_bytes) AS compressed, sum(data_uncompressed_bytes) AS uncompressed FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'aletheia' AND table IN ('events', 'baseline_events') GROUP BY table ORDER BY table

panels.title: Bytes per column — where the space goes
panels.description: raw_verbatim shrinking as verified_rate rises is the whole storage argument.

targets.rawSql: SELECT column, sum(column_data_compressed_bytes) AS compressed, sum(column_data_uncompressed_bytes) AS uncompressed FROM system.parts_columns WHERE active AND database = 'aletheia' AND table = 'events' GROUP BY column ORDER BY compressed DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Recent Merkle batches
panels.description: Batch key is (source_id, partition, minute). Chained roots make a silent edit to an old batch impossible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT merkle_batch, count() AS leaves, min(recv_time) AS first_event, max(recv_time) AS last_event FROM aletheia.events WHERE $__timeFilter(recv_time) AND merkle_batch != '' GROUP BY merkle_batch ORDER BY last_event DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Event lookup (event_uid)
panels.description: Set the event_uid variable, or arrive here from a Loki line via its structured metadata.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_uid, recv_time, source_id, template_id, toString(storage_mode) AS storage_mode, toString(parse_status) AS parse_status, hex(raw_sha256) AS raw_sha256, merkle_batch, vars FROM aletheia.events WHERE event_uid = '$event_uid' LIMIT 10

panels.title: Live normalized feed (Loki)
panels.description: Low-cardinality labels only: vendor, product, source_id, ocsf_class, parse_status.
